raw_document.title: FDA Approves LUMIVEX™ (lumivexinib) for Adult Patients with HER2-Positive Breast Cancer
raw_document.raw_text:
GammaTech Biosciences (NASDAQ: GTEK) today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved LUMIVEX™ (lumivexinib 150 mg tablets) for the treatment of adult patients with unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer who have received one or more prior anti-HER2-based regimens.

The approval is based on the results of the Phase 3 LUMINARY trial (NCT05234567), which demonstrated a statistically significant improvement in progression-free survival.

LUMIVEX™ is a first-in-class HER2-directed kinase inhibitor. The New Drug Application (NDA 217890) was submitted in October 2023 and received Priority Review designation.

LUMIVEX™ will be commercially available within four weeks. GammaTech will work with payers to ensure broad patient access.

'This approval represents a major advance for HER2-positive breast cancer patients,' said the FDA's Office of Oncology Products. The drug was approved under the Accelerated Approval pathway based on tumor response rate as a surrogate endpoint.
